title: Abathunywa Benceba Nobugorha
intro: Khawuthelekelele imva kwemini ezolileyo ephazanyiswa kukufika kwabahambi abangabaziyo. Inkangeleko yabo ayiqhelekanga, kodwa injongo yabo ayifani kwaphela. Baphethe umyalezo kaThixo oza kutshintsha indlela yezizwe ezimbini, uzise uhleko kwikhaya elingenanto kunye noloyiko kwisixeko esinesono. Ngoobani aba ndwendwe bangaqondakaliyo?
clues: Sathunyelwa kumkhonzi ka-Allah ozinikeleyo, owaziwa ngobubele bakhe obungenamda.
Sifike siziphethe njengabantu esingabaziyo, kodwa umninimzi wethu waziva into eyahlukileyo ngobukho bethu.
Sizise iindaba ezabangela ukuba ixhegokazi lihleke lingakholelwa, lizibetha ebusweni limangalisiwe.
Sasinikwe umsebenzi wokukhusela usapho olulungileyo ngelixa sitshabalalisa isixeko esizele bubuqhetseba.
Sala ukutya isidlo esasinikwa sona, nto leyo eyabangela ukuba umninimzi wethu athandabuze ngakumbi.
Sasityhila ubume bethu bokwenyani ngaphambi kokuba simke, sisithi, 'Eneneni, singabathunywa beNkosi yakho.'
